assets.name: desktop-left
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a standalone production decorative PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT background for the desktop side margins of the DaySum couples web app. The attached screenshot is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its warm textured crayon and colored pencil illustration, soft charcoal sketch contours, cream, muted butter yellow, sage green, tiny blush coral accents. Cute, delicate, quiet and handmade. Preserve the handmade texture, no clean vector lines, no 3D, no glossy gradients, no sticker white border, no cast shadow, no opaque rectangular background. Not a UI mockup. No words, no letters, no logo, no buttons. One cohesive airy vignette, portrait 3:4 composition with generous transparent space around the silhouette, objects clustered toward the lower half. Restrained desktop decoration, gentle colors; should complement rather than dominate the provided home screen. Left-side vignette: a little open cream diary with subtly lined blank pages, one small coral heart doodle on a page, a pale yellow pencil laid diagonally across the bottom, a cream ceramic mug with small coral heart and two wisps of warm steam tucked beside it, a tiny sprig of white daisies and sage leaves. A loose buttery-yellow crayon patch just under the objects, fading irregularly into transparent alpha. Two tiny floating coral hearts above. Natural friendly asymmetry, thin lightly grainy charcoal strokes, subdued pastel palette. No characters or cafe background.
